name: Team home content specification
text_content:
Type: instrument

Source: Session 3 of the Scaling People translation program, page sections 11.7 and 14 of the S3 page in the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253. Session task 86ajgmhgx.

For every unit, the workbook's table (mission or reason to exist, objectives with owner, key metrics, accountability mechanisms, cadence), plus the decision-rights register, competency paths, the strategy lists, the definitions register and standing vocabulary, the document list with versions and owners, and the web rendered as the record's designed artifact. Distinct from the OS surface in name and purpose; readable between services in the team's languages. Where it lives is founder-gated.

Specification only. Building is gated on the document methodology (86ajgn2z5). Page section 14 holds the full specification.

comment.text: Session 12 specifies the feedback culture page (I1, work item A9) as the destinations page's coaching and feedback half, beside it and the communication architecture page: each direction's surface, record, and what it may never become; the two kinds of live speech; the placed check-in and the placed line; the rule that the hypothesis has no page; the flag's one sentence; and "held" where a concern about a lead has no destination. It exists in every house language before the first cohort's why block. S12 page, section 17; instrument I1; readiness row 152.

comment.text: Session 11 adds three pages and one rule to the team home: the architecture page (I1), the language list and translation rule as a definitions entry (A9), and the translation record (I2); and the rule that every page exists in every language on the house's list under one version number before it publishes, with a page in one language when the list has two read as not published. The cadence page's "in the languages the team speaks" now has a list to be checked against. S11 page, sections 6.4 and 8.2; P12, P17.
